About Us

Join a growing fresh food retail business known for delivering quality, value and an exceptional customer experience. At Harris Farm Markets, everything we do is driven by our purpose for the Greater Goodness, for our customers, our community, our planet, and each other.

As a proud family owned Australian business, youâll be part of something bigger where your work truly matters.

Here, You Will

  • Do meaningful work that contributes to something bigger
  • Grow your career in more directions than one
  • Build real connections with people who feel like family
  • Be valued for who you are, every day

We reward our people fairly and offer benefits that genuinely matter because great people deserve great things.

We are currently searching for our next superstar Shop Assistant!

You'll help customers find what they need, keep the store looking fresh and abundant, and be part of a team that loves good food and good people. No experience needed, we'll teach you everything. What you bring is a friendly attitude, pride in your work, and a genuine love of great fresh food. Many of our Store Managers started exactly here!

Responsibilities

  • Filling and rotating stock to maintain full, fresh, and appealing displays
  • Keeping the Back of House organised, clean, and well-managed
  • Monitoring stock quality, dates, and rotation (FIFO)
  • Maintaining excellent shelf management for accurate customer convenience
  • Providing helpful, on-the-floor customer service
  • Maintaining food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety standards
  • Supporting the team to ensure smooth daily operations

About You

We are looking for someone who loves food, with previous experience working in a fresh food retail business. Additionally, we are looking for someone with:

  • Strong attention to detail and organisation skills
  • Physically capable of manual handling and being on your feet
  • A team player with a strong work ethic
  • Flexible availability across a 7-day roster AM & PM shifts

Why you should apply

  • If you like variety and love to be physically active
  • Work with a highly successful business
  • Value a career path

At Harris Farm, we welcome everyone, from all walks of life and all abilities. If you think you could be a great Harris Farmer, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the above requirements, please donât be shy - get in touch!

About the Company

Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels.

About the Role

Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues.

You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces.

  • Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers.

  • Classify sellers and verify their authorization status.

  • Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues.

  • Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content.

  • Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details.

  • Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records.

  • Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports.

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics.

  • Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes.

Competencies and Qualifications


Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field.

  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables.

  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

  • Strong written English and reporting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and follow SOPs.

  • Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.

Nice-to-Have

  • Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience.

  • Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools.

  • Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance.

  • Experience with dashboards and reporting.

  • Experience using AI research and translation tools.

Key Qualities

  • Detail-oriented

  • Analytical

  • Investigative

  • Highly organized

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

  • Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.

  • Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

Application Process

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
